---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for ovi.
title: '[FEATURE REQUEST] - '
labels: enhancement
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem**
A clear description of what the problem is. (e.g. I'm missing a specific runtime parameter or device control in the interactive shell...)

**Solution Description**
A clear description of what you want to happen. Does it relate to upcoming features like Custom Modelfiles, the `/x` command interface, or OpenAI-compatible APIs?

**Description of considered alternatives**
A clear description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Is there a pull request associated with this issue**
If so, provide the link to it

**Additional Context**
Add any other context or mockups for the feature request here.
